transcript.author: op_dev
transcript.body: Ask HN: Consumer keeps dropping messages under load, where do I even start? RabbitMQ, one consumer, prefetch unlimited, auto-ack. Under normal traffic everything is fine, at peak a few percent of messages never get processed.

transcript.author: maintainer_dev
transcript.body: Auto-ack is the first thing I would turn off. With auto-ack the broker considers a message delivered the moment it leaves the socket, so a consumer that dies with 2000 messages in its buffer loses all 2000. Manual ack plus a prefetch of a few hundred cost us maybe 5% throughput and the losses went to zero.

transcript.author: op_dev
transcript.body: thanks, that was it. prefetch 1000 with manual ack, already running an hour with zero drops.
